name: Joly Nursery, Primary and College
address: E7 Elejigbo Mega Diamond Estate, Ota, Ogun State
vision: To be a school where every child discovers the value of education, grows in mindset and character, and is prepared to become a confident, responsible leader of tomorrow.
mission: To provide a nurturing and disciplined learning environment, from Nursery through College, where children build strong foundations in knowledge, values and creativity, guided by caring teachers and supported by partnership with parents.

We help children think well, stay curious and persevere.
We build character and integrity alongside academics.
We nurture every child within a warm, supportive community.
We develop children in academics, sports, arts and leadership.
We work together with parents for the good of each child.
objectives: Build strong foundations in literacy, numeracy and core subjects.
Nurture good character, discipline and respect.
Encourage creativity, curiosity and independent thinking.

why: Modern learning with a focus on strong foundations.

director.name: Hunkanrin Daniel Gbemenu
director.title: Founder and Director

director.short: Founder and Director Hunkanrin Daniel Gbemenu champions education and the growth of mindset, guided by the belief that education is the greatest treasure.
bio: **Hunkanrin Daniel Gbemenu** is the Founder and Director of Joly Nursery, Primary and College. A graduate of Political Science (BSc) from Ekiti State University, he is a firm believer in the power of education to shape lives and communities. He holds that real learning goes beyond textbooks and examinations. It involves the growth of mindset, helping children think well, grow in character and approach life with confidence.
Guided by the school's motto, *"Education is the greatest treasure,"* he founded Joly Nursery, Primary and College in 2025 to give children a strong foundation in learning and values.
welcome: Welcome to Joly Nursery, Primary and College.

Our school's motto, *"Education is the greatest treasure,"* is a conviction that shapes everything we do. A good education does more than prepare a child for examinations. It shapes how a child thinks, how they treat others, and how they face the future.

At Joly, we believe in the growth of mindset. We want every child to be curious, to ask questions, to persevere through difficulty, and to see learning as something to enjoy for life. We believe that a strong foundation in the early years, built on knowledge, good character and sound values, prepares a child for whatever comes next.

We are a vibrant school, founded in August 2025, and we are building with care and purpose. We welcome parents as partners in this work, because a child grows best when home and school pull in the same direction.
I warmly invite you to visit us, meet our team, and see that Joly is the right place for your child.
